edit.statement: Every Argentine province is represented by three national senators.
edit.subject: Argentine province
edit.scope: Covers the 23 provinces; the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires, which also has three senators, is not a province.

notes: Real: since the 1994 constitutional reform each province and the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires elect three senators, 72 in all (Argentine Constitution art. 54; Wikipedia, Argentine Senate). Rarely stated in English text, and models often guess two by analogy with the US Senate.
